summary: Frontend-only testing completed for the new Rescue Code/Rejestracja WebView mechanism. Web flow is stable: /akcja/karty-ratownicze loads, validation works in both modes, and on web both actions correctly fall back to external URL opening. Route /akcja/ratownicze-webview renders fallback UI with expected messaging and open action.

ui_bugs.issue: Interactive fallback button ('Otwórz stronę') has no testID/data-testid, reducing E2E reliability for mobile-web regression.

action_items: Add testID to 'Otwórz stronę' Pressable in /akcja/ratownicze-webview for stable automation.

Main agent should run native runtime verification (Android/iOS) for WebView injectedJavaScript effectiveness on rescue.euroncap.com and kartyratownicze.pl, because web preview cannot execute native WebView path.
critical_code_review_comments: karty-ratownicze.tsx now correctly routes native users via router.push('/akcja/ratownicze-webview', {target, query}) for both Rescue Code and Rejestracja paths; web keeps safe Linking.openURL fallback.
rescueCards.ts helper scripts implement repeated attempts with query prefill + submit triggers, matching intended resilient auto-fill behavior.
Akcja stack includes ratownicze-webview route, preserving standard stack navigation semantics.
Web fallback behavior is verified end-to-end: both CTA buttons trigger external URLs even when auto-transfer is unavailable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on public preview URL from frontend env. Confirmed via runtime hook that web buttons call external URLs: rescue.euroncap.com/#/search and kartyratownicze.pl/wyszukaj-za-darmo/. Native WebView injection path remains unverified in this environment.
rca_of_issue: No blocking regression in tested web flow. Remaining gap is testability: missing testID on fallback open button. Reproduction: open /akcja/ratownicze-webview?target=karty-ratownicze&query=WX12345 and inspect DOM for fallback CTA; no data-testid present. Mitigation: add explicit testID prop.
test_credentials: Not required for this frontend-only scope (no auth flow tested).
